segments.text: This episode continues the family’s trip to Hawaii. Everyone wants a different kind of vacation, and most of them have trouble relaxing in the way they planned.
segments.tts_text: [a warm storyteller inviting the listener into the story] This episode continues the family’s trip to Hawaii. Everyone wants a different kind of vacation, and most of them have trouble relaxing in the way they planned.

segments.text: Phil wants to turn the trip into the honeymoon he and Claire never really had. Claire says that traveling with three children doesn’t feel like a vacation, but Phil convinces her to leave the kids with Mitchell and Cameron and spend some time alone with him.

Claire says that traveling with three children doesn’t feel like a vacation, but Phil convinces her to leave the kids with Mitchell and Cameron and spend some time alone with him.

segments.text: They go to the adults-only pool, and Claire finally starts to relax. Then Haley appears and says she’s going out with some teenagers she just met. Claire wants to stop her, but Phil encourages her to trust Haley and enjoy the day.

segments.text: A few hours later, Alex tells them that Haley is drunk and throwing up in the bathroom. Claire takes care of her and warns her that alcohol will always make her feel this terrible. Phil’s romantic plan seems to be over, but he has one more surprise.

segments.text: He arranges a small wedding ceremony so they can finally have the wedding they missed years ago. The whole family joins them as they renew their vows.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Jay plans to spend the vacation eating, drinking, and doing nothing. Then his brother calls and reminds him that their father died at sixty-three, the same age Jay has just turned. Jay suddenly becomes worried about his health.

segments.text: He starts exercising, swimming, and choosing healthy food. Gloria gets annoyed because she brought him to Hawaii to relax, not to turn the trip into a fitness camp. Jay pushes himself too hard and eventually hurts his back while getting into a hammock.

segments.text: Phil finds him stuck there and helps him return to the family. Jay finally tells Gloria why he’s been acting differently. He doesn’t want to die young like his father. Gloria understands, but she also reminds him that enjoying life matters.

segments.text: Jay finally relaxes and orders the food he wanted in the first place.

segments.text: Mitchell has almost the opposite problem. He wants to spend the trip sightseeing, while Cameron would rather sit by the pool and do nothing. Mitchell goes off on his own to visit a lavender farm, but when he comes back, he’s still annoyed that Cameron didn’t go with him.

segments.text: He even makes up a story about meeting Elton John there just to make Cameron jealous.

segments.text: Later, Cameron gets Mitchell to finally sit down and relax. Hotel workers put his feet up, hand him a drink, and even massage him. Mitchell is surprised by how good it feels. For the first time, he understands why Cameron is perfectly happy doing nothing on vacation.

segments.text: Unfortunately, the two of them are so relaxed that they accidentally leave Lily behind in an elevator, and Gloria has to bring her back.

segments.text: The vacation is messy, and hardly anyone follows the original plan. Still, Phil and Claire finally get their wedding, Jay finds a better balance, and Mitchell finally learns how to slow down and enjoy the trip.
